appUpdates.title: Application update
appUpdates.notice: A new release is ready. Install it when convenient.
appUpdates.current: You are using the latest version.
appUpdates.checkHint: Check GitHub for a newer stable release.
appUpdates.preserve: The application will restart. The exe and entire locales folder will be replaced; their backup is retained in .osp-control-backups beside the application. Custom translations can be recovered from it. Settings are preserved. The archive is verified against GitHub's SHA-256 digest.
